# PDF.js Vendor Files

This directory contains PDF.js files used by the development reader as a comparison renderer for PDF.js and difference views.

The files are not a runtime fallback for pdf-crumb.js and are not bundled into the `dist/pdf-crumb*.min.js` renderer files.

`pdf.mjs` and `pdf.worker.mjs` are copyright 2024 Mozilla Foundation and licensed under the Apache License, Version 2.0. Their original license notices are retained at the top of each file.

Source project: https://github.com/mozilla/pdf.js
